title: Sunscreen SPF50

drivers.name: Promotion: 30% off
drivers.evidence: Past 30% off (2025-09-08) lifted sales x1.26; deeper discount (27.1%) than previous 30% off, but no prior 30% off in November. Noise-adjusted uplift from 8 past promotions is x1.02. Shrink to +15% due to low frequency and seasonal weakness.

adjustment.analysis: The 30% discount is deeper than past promotions (max 25% off) and coincides with a seasonal lull (post-Labor Day, no major event). The noise-adjusted uplift from past 30% off events is x1.02, but one past instance (2025-09-08) saw a 26% lift. The current price drop is 27.1%, slightly deeper, but no past 30% off in this season. The baseline trend is down (-21.9% over 13 weeks), and recent sales are declining. No evidence of pantry loading. The classical model’s x1.02 is too low. Adjust upward with caution: the discount is rare and deep, but seasonal context weakens lift. Shrink toward 1.0 due to low signal and noisy history.

This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-77% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
